scenarios.title: Scenario A: High Dry Heat (Desert/North-West Flow)
scenarios.description: 40°C ambient dry-bulb temperature with low relative humidity (20%) and moderate wind (3.5 m/s). Allows substantial evaporative cooling through sweating.

expected_outcome.risk_level: Moderate to High (depending on ward vulnerability)

scenarios.title: Scenario B: Lethal Humid Heat (Monsoon Break / Compounding Humidity)
scenarios.description: Identical 40°C air temperature but with high relative humidity (70%) and stagnant low wind (1.0 m/s). Human sweat cannot evaporate, halting core thermoregulation.

expected_outcome.risk_level: Very High / Emergency Alert (Critical hyperthermia risk)

scenarios.title: Scenario C: June 2024 Delhi Multi-Day Heatwave Spike
scenarios.description: Retrospective hindcast scenario representing the severe June 2024 heatwave: 44.5°C ambient, 42% humidity, persistent 4-day exposure with high solar load.

scenarios.title: Scenario D: Baseline Spring/Mild Summer
scenarios.description: 30°C temperature, 40% humidity, pleasant breeze (3.0 m/s), moderate solar radiation.
